arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-21' AND date < '2019-10-28'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made in the last full Monday-to-Sunday week before the last day of the data.
assumptions: "Last week" is measured from the last day of the data, 2019-10-31 (a Thursday), not from today.
"Last week" means the last full Monday-to-Sunday week before the week containing 2019-10-31: Monday 2019-10-21 to Sunday 2019-10-27, inclusive.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, an error or a negative amount.
